integrity: All finite claims have explicit bitmask witnesses, exact-rational primal and dual certificates, and replayable exhaustive maximum-clique source; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact single-substitution integer and fractional results for Dyck words of semilength at most six only; full binary received alphabet; no asymptotic, optimizer census, or stream decoding theorem. Priority subject to unindexed literature.
title: First fractional Hamming-sphere packing gap for single-substitution codes on Dyck words
